source: Hilber, Hughes and Taylor (1977), Improved numerical dissipation for time integration algorithms in structural dynamics, Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 5, 283–292; the amplification matrix follows directly from the published equilibrium and Newmark kinematics.
